To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) innovation can be seen as an outcome of a complex bargaining process, 2) innovation is a non-linear process in which the outcome is not necessarily optimal for the individual actors involved, 3) innovation is a process in which actors with conflicting goals interact and negotiate, 4) innovation is a complex process in which the actors involved have different interests and power, and 5) the outcome of innovation is a compromise between different interests and power positions of the actors involved.
